title: Quality pattern: secure, accessible authentication
text:
STORY
As a registered user, I want to sign in with my approved account, so that I can access my private workspace.

SCOPE
Includes valid sign-in, invalid credentials, locked/disabled accounts, session creation, keyboard operation, error recovery, and audit events. Password-reset and account registration are out of scope.

AC-01 VALID SIGN-IN
GIVEN an active account exists and no authenticated session exists
WHEN the user submits valid credentials
THEN one authenticated session is created AND the private workspace opens AND the password is absent from logs and responses.

AC-02 INVALID SIGN-IN
GIVEN no authenticated session exists
WHEN an invalid username/password pair is submitted
THEN access is denied AND a non-enumerating error is shown AND no authenticated session is created.

AC-03 ACCESSIBILITY
GIVEN the sign-in page is operated with a keyboard and screen reader
WHEN validation fails
THEN focus moves to the error summary AND each error is programmatically associated with its field AND the user can retry without losing the username.

NFR
Security: authentication attempts and lockouts produce auditable events without credential values. Performance: the team must agree a measured response-time threshold before approval.

OPEN QUESTIONS
What lockout and session-expiration policy is authoritative? Which identity provider and MFA rules apply?

title: Quality pattern: least-privilege role change
text:
STORY
As an organization administrator, I want to change a member's role, so that access matches current responsibilities.

SCOPE
Includes role selection, authorization, last-administrator protection, concurrent changes, confirmation, and an audit trail.

AC-01 AUTHORIZED CHANGE
GIVEN the actor has role-management permission AND the target belongs to the organization
WHEN the actor selects an allowed role and confirms
THEN the new role applies to subsequent authorization checks AND the old role no longer grants access AND an audit record captures actor, target, old role, new role, and time.

AC-02 FORBIDDEN CHANGE
GIVEN the actor lacks role-management permission
WHEN a role-change request is submitted through the UI or API
THEN the request is rejected without changing membership AND the response does not reveal roles outside the actor's visibility.

AC-03 INVARIANT
GIVEN the target is the organization's only active administrator
WHEN a change would remove administrator access
THEN the change is rejected with a recovery-oriented explanation.

AC-04 CONCURRENCY
GIVEN membership changed after the actor loaded the page
WHEN the stale update is submitted
THEN no newer value is overwritten AND the actor is prompted to reload.

OPEN QUESTIONS
Which roles exist? Can administrators change their own role? What retention period applies to audit records?

title: Quality pattern: asynchronous data export
text:
STORY
As an analyst, I want to export the currently filtered results, so that I can perform approved offline analysis.

SCOPE
Includes filter snapshot, asynchronous generation, status, authorization recheck, expiry, cancellation, errors, and observability.

AC-01 START EXPORT
GIVEN the analyst can view the filtered records
WHEN an export is requested
THEN the system snapshots the effective filter and returns a non-guessable job identifier without blocking the page.

AC-02 COMPLETE EXPORT
GIVEN the export job succeeds and access is still authorized
WHEN the analyst downloads before expiry
THEN the file contains exactly the authorized snapshot columns/rows AND formula-leading values are neutralized AND the response uses the configured filename and content type.

AC-03 AUTHORIZATION CHANGE
GIVEN access is revoked after request but before download
WHEN download is attempted
THEN access is denied even if the job identifier is known.

AC-04 FAILURE AND RETRY
GIVEN generation fails
WHEN status is viewed
THEN a safe actionable failure is shown AND operators can correlate the failure using a non-sensitive trace identifier AND duplicate retry behavior is defined.

NFR
Privacy: generated files are encrypted at rest and deleted after an explicitly agreed retention period. Observability: queue delay, execution time, result size, failures, and deletion are measurable without exported content.

OPEN QUESTIONS
What formats, volume limit, retention period, localization, and notification channels are required?
